content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p35","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A tucked-away temple where the river bends, all mossy stone and quiet steps."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old carvings and a story in every corner, the kind of place that slows you right down."},{"poi_id":"p55","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Grab a plate of the good stuff, rich and spicy, just like the locals do."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p126","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sea temple on a rock, best when the tide rolls in and the light turns gold."},{"poi_id":"p22","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Scandi-style coffee stop with a side of Bali buzz, good for a slow sip."},{"poi_id":"p25","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Mixed rice plate that locals queue for, the kind of lunch that fuels a temple run."},{"poi_id":"p125","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Monkey-filled temple where the trees feel older than the stories."},{"poi_id":"p94","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sit-down dinner with a view that makes you forget the drive."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p139","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A quieter melukat spot where the water feels ancient and the moss does most of the talking."},{"poi_id":"p140","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The springs here have been washing away worries for centuries, so step in with a clean heart."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Carved shrines rise out of the green valley like the rock itself remembered how to pray."},{"poi_id":"p42","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A tiny warung with big flavours, the kind of place where the menu changes but the welcome never does."},{"poi_id":"p38","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Local dishes done with a little extra flair, and a garden that makes you want to linger."}]}
Sunny Ubud to a temple farewell, every must-do tucked in — the sun won't wait, and neither will we.
